verdict.rationale: A live probe found an official llms.txt (HTTP 200) at support.pagerduty.com describing PagerDuty's documentation, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Docs pages are also served as raw Markdown (.md URLs and the GitHub developer-docs repo), and an official OpenAPI schema repo is published. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/agent-oriented docs offering and its scope, evidence of llms.txt coverage on developer.pagerduty.com, independent corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://support.pagerduty.com/llms.txt # PagerDuty Documentation
